question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Meander
solution:
The correct answer is: **Direct**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"meander"** means to follow a winding and turning course; to wander aimlessly. (भटकना)

 
 
• **Example: **The river meanders through the valley, creating picturesque views at every turn.
 
 
 
• **"Direct" **refers to a straight path or route without any detours or deviations; clear and straightforward. (सीधा)
 
 
• **Example: **She gave him direct instructions to complete the task without any confusion.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'meander' **is **'direct'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Direct**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Ramble **(बातचीत या लेखन में असंबद्धता से भटकना): To talk or write at length in a confused or inconsequential way.

 
 
• **Example:** He tends to ramble when he is nervous, making it hard to follow his point.
 
 
 
• **Depute **(प्रतिनिधि नियुक्त करना): To appoint or delegate someone to a position or task.
 
 
• **Example: **The manager decided to depute his assistant to attend the meeting on his behalf.
 
 
 
• **Confirm **(पुष्टि करना): To establish the truth or correctness of something.
 
 
• **Example:** Please confirm your attendance at the event by responding to the invitation.
